prompt: I already verified that jenkins-legacy in namespace jenkins-legacy is crashing because the pipeline-model-api plugin is pinned to an incompatible version (2.2277.v00573e73ddf1) in its config. Trace where this is defined in source/config so I can fix it at the source. Read-only only.
expected_output: The answer should locate where the pinned plugin version lives in live config — the jenkins-legacy ConfigMap, key plugins.txt — citing the exact ConfigMap name and key, note the Helm/Argo-managed labels (chart jenkins-5.8.92), and recommend the source change WITHOUT executing helm upgrade or any kubectl patch/apply.
context: Deeper source/config trace as a self-contained follow-up (mirrors the 'Trace source/config' button prompt). The pinned versions live in ConfigMap/jenkins-legacy key plugins.txt; list_namespace_resources only shows the ConfigMap exists, so the agent must search_configmaps by the version string and get_configmap to read plugins.txt. Deployment-repo tools are not available to the agent.
notes: Fails if the agent does not inspect the live ConfigMap data (search_configmaps + get_configmap) to find plugins.txt, or if it emits an executable helm/kubectl fix instead of pointing at the source location.
